verdict.line: You lose if you trade autos into a full-charge Riven who just landed an ability (Runic Blade is charged); you win by baiting her Valor (E) and all three Broken Wings (Q) charges empty before you commit Infernal Chains (W) and your empowered auto.

brief.thesis: This sits at 46.4% over 403 games — a genuine coinflip, not a Riven-favoured lane, despite her having more discrete trade tools per cycle (three Q dashes, a W stun, an E damage-block). Every one of those tools is finite and short-cooldown: Q is 13s, W is 11-7s, E is 10-6s. Whoever reacts to the other's empty kit — her spent charges, your on-cooldown Deathbringer Stance — wins the exchange, which is exactly why the sample sits near 50%.

theirWindow.when: Ki Burst (W) up + all 3 Q charges ready
theirWindow.what: This is her all-in: W stun into chained Broken Wings, the third hit knocking back. Hold Umbral Dash (E) to sidestep the stun or the final knockback — dashing through breaks her combo timing and opens a gap for your empowered auto.

yourWindow.when: her Valor (E) and Q charges are on cooldown
yourWindow.what: Without Valor's damage block or Broken Wings mobility she can't negate burst or disengage. Land Infernal Chains (W), then stack Q swings and your Deathbringer Stance auto for a clean, unanswered trade.

runes.keystoneWhy: The adaptive force and healing scale directly with the prolonged skirmishes this matchup produces once her burst window closes.

summoners.why: Highest pick rate (65.4%) at a matching 47.7% win rate — Ignite closes out the solo-kill window this data flags as favouring Aatrox.

playing.title: Track her Runic Blade charge
playing.detail: Riven's autos deal bonus damage only when an ability has just charged her blade. Avoid trading autos into her the instant she lands Q or W — wait a beat for the charge to burn off.

playing.title: Dash through her third Q
playing.detail: Umbral Dash (E) lets you cross through or past the final Broken Wings knockback, denying the combo's payoff while you're still dealing damage from the dash's passive heal.

playing.title: Don't burst into an up Valor
playing.detail: Her E blocks incoming damage on activation. Bait it out with a Q swing or wave contact first, then commit your real damage once it's down.

playing.title: Drag overextensions with Infernal Chains
playing.detail: If she pushes up without her Q charges or Valor available, W's drag mechanic denies her only clean way to leave the impact area.

playing.title: Use the double-ult window deliberately
playing.detail: At level 6, World Ender fears nearby minions and boosts your AD, healing, and Move Speed — clear her wave pressure and commit to the fight before she gets a free Wind Slash off Blade of the Exile.

playing.title: Time Deathbringer Stance before trades
playing.detail: Check your passive icon before initiating — an empowered auto adds burst and a heal based on her max health, swinging close trades in your favor.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and the 46.4% head-to-head figure are measured from live OP.GG games on the current patch; the mechanical reasoning and trade windows are my own analysis layered on top.

stats.opponentTip: Keep an eye out on Riven’s Conqueror stacks before fighting her. Dodge her third (Q) with [E] while dealing damage.
